post.summary: Create a short-lived non-production demo session for the live API demo.
post.description: Disabled by default and forced off in production. Intended only for local or controlled demo environments.

post.summary: Process a signed web-checkout subscription event into student entitlements.
post.description: Server-to-server endpoint. The provider eventId is the idempotency key; clients must not send learner credentials or raw payment secrets.

200.description: Webhook accepted and entitlement projection updated or deduplicated

post.summary: Create an Eiken Grade 3 learner profile and determine guardian requirements.

get.summary: Read the current learner's guardian-link state.

post.summary: Create a short-lived guardian invitation code for the current minor student.
post.description: Bearer student only. The raw invite code is returned once to the student client; only a server-side hash is stored.

put.summary: Verify a guardian invitation code and bind the Bearer guardian to the student.
put.description: Bearer guardian only. Accepts the one-time invite code, hashes it server-side, and verifies the pending guardian link if the invite has not expired.

put.summary: Record voice-processing consent for a verified minor as the linked Bearer guardian.
put.description: Bearer guardian only. The student must be a minor with a verified guardian link whose guardian_id matches the authenticated guardian.

200.description: Guardian consent recorded for the verified minor

put.summary: Record or withdraw the current voice-processing consent version.
put.description: Supports Bearer student self-write for non-minor learners. Deprecated X-Student-Id/X-Guardian-Id headers remain only for legacy compatibility and minor guardian consent policy.
Consent writes may be attributed to the verified guardian actor. Legacy X-Guardian-Id is deprecated and retained only for compatibility.

get.summary: Resolve server-authoritative learning, voice, commerce, notification, LINE-return, and entitlement capabilities.

put.summary: Register or refresh the authenticated student's current device metadata.
put.description: Bearer student only. Stores a server-side hash of deviceId plus platform and version metadata. Push tokens are intentionally out of scope for this endpoint.

200.description: Current device metadata registered or refreshed

put.summary: Disable push notifications for the authenticated student's current registered device.
put.description: Bearer student only. Identifies the existing current device by platform and deviceId metadata, sets push_enabled=false, and defensively clears any stored push token envelope. This endpoint does not accept push tokens.

200.description: Push disabled for the current registered device

post.summary: Request a constrained S3-compatible signed upload ticket after guardian and Consent Gate checks.
post.description: Returns a short-lived SigV4 POST policy when voice feature flags, current consent, guardian status, request limits, and object storage configuration all pass. Legacy student headers are retained only for compatibility routes and are disabled in production.

501.description: Gate passed, but object storage signing is not configured

post.summary: Start a formal stage exam attempt from the Bearer student identity.

201.description: Formal stage attempt started or idempotently replayed

get.summary: List the current Bearer student's materialized mastery and due projections.
get.description: Returns only existing student_knowledge projection rows for the authenticated Student. It does not materialize state=new rows and does not allow Guardian-derived student inference.

200.description: Student mastery/due projections ordered by dueAt then knowledgePointRef

get.summary: Read the current Bearer student's Quest progress, XP, activity coins, and badges.
get.description: Student-only formal API. Rewards are projected only from server-verified learning and guardian-link events.

200.description: Current Quest progress and reward wallet

get.summary: List a verified guardian's child mastery and due projections.
get.description: Bearer guardian only. The target student must be linked to the authenticated guardian with a verified guardian link.

200.description: Child mastery/due projections ordered by dueAt then knowledgePointRef

get.summary: Read a verified guardian's child learning summary.
get.description: Bearer guardian only. Aggregates child mastery projections and Quest state into guardian-readable report copy.

get.summary: Read the current Bearer student's open formal stage attempt snapshot.

post.summary: Submit all formal stage attempt answers and receive the server-scored result.

get.summary: Read the current Bearer student's submitted formal stage attempt result.

post.summary: Consume the learner’s one-time trial eligibility and return the first question without its answer.

201.description: Trial started; starting consumes the one-time entitlement

post.summary: Submit exactly the current trial answer; raw answers and durable progress are not stored.

409.description: Answer is duplicated or out of sequence

StudentId.name: X-Student-Id
StudentId.description: Scaffold-only identity header; replace with verified bearer-token middleware. Deprecated: use Authorization Bearer actor claims.

GuardianId.name: X-Guardian-Id
GuardianId.description: Scaffold-only linked guardian identity, required when a minor's consent is written. Replace with verified actor claims. Deprecated: use Authorization Bearer actor claims.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Required for formal stage-attempt start runtime and planned for future submit routes. ASCII 8-128 using A-Z, a-z, 0-9, dot, underscore, colon, or hyphen.

FormalIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
FormalIdempotencyKey.description: Required for formal stage-attempt start runtime. ASCII 8-128 using A-Z, a-z, 0-9, dot, underscore, colon, or hyphen.

IfMatchRevision.name: If-Match-Revision
IfMatchRevision.description: planned future contract: If-Match-Revision will be required for revisioned writes once runtime revision support is implemented. Not implemented in this slice.

LegacyGuardianHeader.name: X-Guardian-Id
LegacyGuardianHeader.description: Deprecated compatibility guardian actor for consent writes; use verified bearer actor claims.

Forbidden.description: Guardian or voice consent gate denied the operation

ServiceUnavailable.description: Required backend configuration is not available

CurrentDeviceRegistrationRequest.description: Current device metadata for cross-platform capability and future notification routing. Raw deviceId is hashed server-side and push tokens are not accepted here.

pushEnabled.description: Always false until push-token registration and provider integrations land.

CurrentDevicePushDisableRequest.description: Current device metadata used to disable push. Raw deviceId is hashed server-side and push tokens are intentionally not accepted.

CurrentDevicePushDisableResponse.description: Current device state after push is disabled. pushEnabled is false.

pushEnabled.description: False after disabling push for the current registered device.

DemoSessionResponse.description: Short-lived non-production demo credentials. Disabled by default and forced off in production.

studentToken.description: Short-lived demo Bearer token for the minor student actor.

guardianToken.description: Short-lived demo Bearer token for the guardian actor.

contentLengthBytes.description: Requested upload size in bytes. The server enforces the configured maximum in the signed policy.

durationSeconds.description: Client-measured audio duration in seconds. The server enforces the configured maximum before signing.

checksumSha256.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 checksum recorded as signed object metadata.

fields.description: S3-compatible POST form fields, including key, policy, x-amz-* signature fields, content type, and signed metadata.

entitlements.description: Server-side active or grace-period entitlement codes for the current student. Expired, revoked, or past valid_until records are omitted.

StableErrorCode.description: Stable error-code registry. IDEMPOTENCY_REPLAY is deprecated and retained only for compatibility; P1.1 does not emit it.

StartStageAttemptResponse.description: Formal P1.3 Start/Get runtime response. Item and option IDs are immutable attempt snapshot IDs and do not expose private answer keys.

SubmitStageAttemptRequest.description: Formal P1.3 submit runtime request. Null selectedOptionId explicitly represents a skipped item. Client score, passed, mastery, due, occurred_at, or evidence fields are not accepted.

StageAttemptResultResponse.description: Formal P1.3 server-scored result. Scores are derived from immutable answer-key snapshots, not client-supplied values.

GameRewardGrant.description: Server-awarded Quest reward derived from verified learning or guardian-link events.

StudentGameStateResponse.description: Current Quest progress, XP, activity coins, and earned badges for the authenticated student.

GuardianLearningSummaryResponse.description: Guardian-readable summary generated from child mastery projections and Quest state.

StudentKnowledgeProjection.description: Current P1.3-6 materialized mastery/due projection. It mirrors student_knowledge rows and excludes future fields such as stabilityDays or attemptCount.

WebCheckoutWebhookRequest.description: Signed web checkout subscription event. eventId is the webhook idempotency key.

BearerAuth.description: Verified actor bearer authentication. Required for formal stage-attempt runtime; legacy identity headers are not accepted on formal routes.

LegacyStudentHeader.name: X-Student-Id
LegacyStudentHeader.description: Deprecated compatibility identity used by the current scaffold runtime; replace with planned BearerAuth middleware.

LegacyGuardianHeader.name: X-Guardian-Id
LegacyGuardianHeader.description: Deprecated compatibility guardian actor used by the current scaffold runtime; replace with planned BearerAuth middleware.

WebhookSignature.name: X-PeraQuest-Webhook-Signature
WebhookSignature.description: Lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 over the canonical JSON payload using WEB_CHECKOUT_WEBHOOK_SECRET.

x-runtime-contract-status.authentication: BearerAuth is implemented for formal stage-attempt runtime; deprecated X-Student-Id/X-Guardian-Id headers remain only for legacy non-formal compatibility routes
x-runtime-contract-status.idempotency: formal stage-attempt start and submit use Idempotency-Key; deprecated compatibility-only IDEMPOTENCY_REPLAY is not emitted
x-runtime-contract-status.revision: planned: If-Match-Revision is not implemented and is not currently required
